# Rebel Lion Labs

> Rebel Lion Labs (RL Labs) is a small studio in Cork, Ireland, founded by Levent Arslan, an IT manager with a background in tech and cybersecurity. We build websites for small businesses (from €595), set up and connect AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and Claude Code and train teams to use them (from €750), and build native iPhone apps (first version from €7,950). We work in person around Cork and online across Ireland. Every project gets a fixed written quote before work starts.

## Services
- [Web design for small businesses in Cork](https://rebellionlabs.app/services/websites): packages, prices, redesigns, timelines, ownership
- [AI set-up and training](https://rebellionlabs.app/services/ai): Microsoft 365 Copilot and Gemini set-up, ChatGPT and Claude workspaces, automations and AI agents, Claude Code with plugins, skills and MCP, team training and AI use policies
- [iPhone app development](https://rebellionlabs.app/services/apps): discovery sprint, first version, App Store submission, care
- [All services and prices](https://rebellionlabs.app/services)

## Work
- [PADLR. case study](https://rebellionlabs.app/work/padlr): our own padel app for iPhone and its website, playpadlr.app
- [All projects](https://rebellionlabs.app/work): websites for local businesses and AI set-ups for Your Best Life and All About Cork
